description: Get everything Wilderness Times holds on one tent or product from its gear search: the full review summary, specs, pros and cons, which retailers stock it, and — for a tent — its six category scores, community rating, other sizes of the same model, and two similar tents from other brands. Suited to narrowing to one item, comparing two in detail, or finding what else is like a given tent.

id.description: The id shown beside the item in gear search results.

kind.description: The kind from the same result. Optional; it removes ambiguity, since tents and products are numbered separately.

name: get_gear
title: Get gear details
